"content": "# MCPJam Inspector\n\n- [MCPJam Docs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/index.md): Test, debug, and evaluate MCP servers, MCP ap

n- [Hosted App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/overview.md): Use MCPJam Inspector in the browser, no installation required\n- [MCP

erver: projects, saved servers, evals, and user testing\n- [Okta SSO & SCIM](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/sso.md): Install MCPJa
m from the Okta Integration Network and configure SAML single sign-on and SCIM provisioning\n- [IP Allowlisting](https://docs.mcpj

r error code means, the likely causes, and the next step to fix it.\n- [Changelog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/changelog/overview.md):

r/clients.md): Reusable MCP client configurations for testing servers and apps under realistic conditions\n- [Multi-server connect
ions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/connecting-servers.md): Connect to multiple MCP servers with different transport methods\n
